body: ONNX Runtime: cross-platform, high performance ML inferencing and training accelerator
plain_description: ONNX Runtime accelerates machine learning inference and training across virtually any hardware, reducing infrastructure costs and improving application responsiveness. It works with models from PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and other major frameworks without requiring deep infrastructure changes. The result: faster ML performance in production with fewer resources.
technical_description: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training engine for ONNX-format models. It applies graph-level optimizations and selects the optimal execution provider (CPU, CUDA, TensorRT, CoreML, OpenVINO, DirectML, WebGPU, and others) for the target hardware. The C++ core exposes C, Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, and Rust language bindings. Training acceleration integrates with existing PyTorch training scripts via a single-line API change, supporting multi-node NVIDIA GPU clusters with distributed data-parallel and mixed-precision training. The project includes quantization tooling and transformer-specific optimization pipelines for latency and throughput tuning in production.
title: ONNX Runtime
